articles.title: A giant crayfish contest leads scientists to a growing mystery
articles.summary: A friendly contest over giant crayfish helped scientists find that North American crayfish seem to hit a size limit.

articles.title: Big and small black holes seem to follow the same rule for blasting jets
articles.summary: Astronomers found that black holes of very different sizes seem to launch jets according to the same rule.

articles.title: Ancient pollen shows how fast the land changed around ice age footprints
articles.summary: Pollen in ancient New Mexico footprints shows the people who made them lived through fast ice age changes.
